title: Conformal Selection under Prevalence Shift: FDR Bounds and Finite Calibration
abstract: arXiv:2606.22336v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Conformalized Benjamini--Hochberg (cfBH) uses labeled calibration data to select candidates while controlling the false discovery rate (FDR) under suitable assumptions. We examine how differences between source and test populations affect FDR and power. When non-target scores have the same distribution in both populations, existing results guarantee FDR control for clipped cfBH if non-targets are at least as common in the source population as in the test population. When this prevalence condition fails, FDR can exceed the nominal level. We determine the worst-case FDR in large samples. For example, a nominal level of 10\% can yield FDR approaching 40\% when the source population has 20\% non-targets and the test population has 80\%. translated_title: 流行率偏移下的共形选择：FDR界与有限校准
translated_abstract: 共形化的Benjamini–Hochberg方法（cfBH）利用带标签的校准数据来筛选候选对象，并在适当假设下控制错误发现率（FDR）。我们研究了源总体与测试总体之间的差异如何影响FDR与功效。当非目标样本的得分在两个总体中服从相同分布时，已有结果保证：只要非目标样本在源总体中的占比不低于其在测试总体中的占比，截断版cfBH即可实现FDR控制。当这一流行率条件不成立时，FDR可能超过名义水平。我们确定了大样本情形下FDR的最坏情况：例如，当源总体中非目标占比为20%、而测试总体中为80%时，10%的名义水平可能导致FDR接近40%。仅使用带标签的非目标样本进行校准，在其得分分布仍然一致的条件下，可以避免对非目标比例的这一限制。然而，任何非空的选择结果都必须包含一个最小数量的……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该文揭示了源总体与测试总体之间的流行率偏移会破坏cfBH方法的FDR控制，并给出大样本下的最坏情形FDR界（如名义10%可升至近40%），同时证明在非目标得分分布一致的条件下，仅用带标签非目标样本校准可摆脱对非目标比例的限制。
en_tdlr: This paper shows how prevalence shift between source and test populations can inflate the FDR of conformalized Benjamini–Hochberg selection, derives worst-case large-sample FDR bounds (e.g., a nominal 10% level can approach 40%), and proves that calibrating only on labeled non-targets removes the prevalence restriction provided their score distributions agree.
